website.note: Page reorganized as 'Diagnostic Candidates - Updates Coming Soon!' - no active clinical drug development disclosed.

excluded_legacy_terminated.status: ASCEND-NASH wound down April 2024 (151/336 enrolled, enrollment paused April 2023). Company has discontinued clinical drug development of rencofilstat and pivoted to diagnostics.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Hepion wound down its lead asset rencofilstat (ASCEND-NASH) in April 2024, was delisted from Nasdaq in May 2025 (now trades OTC), and pivoted to in-licensed diagnostics (celiac, respiratory multiplex, H. pylori, HCC ctRNA biomarker from Cirna Diagnostics, March 2026). The pipeline page on hepionpharma.com lists only 'Diagnostic Candidates - Updates Coming Soon!' with no clinical-stage drug assets. CTRVP is a non-common security (preferred/warrant class) of Hepion on OTC; no active P1/P2/P3 drug pipeline.
